name: A commission from Booty Bay

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

summary: Bodley remembers a commission from Gremnik Rizzlesprang, a goblin smuggler-wizard out of Booty Bay. The job was to take Lord Valthalak’s spellbook from Blackrock Spire. Bodley does not know whether Gremnik meant to study it or sell it, and the manual leaves that motive unresolved. The distinction matters: the company’s contract is documented, but its patron’s private purpose is not.
